tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gtor chog nyung 'dus bzhugs so// na mo gu ru bhya/ ngag gi dbang phyug pod ral can/ /kun dga'i ring lugs skyong ba la/ /rin chen sgron me sa skya pa/ /bdud kyi stobs 'phrog zhabs la 'dud/ /'dir sa skya pa'i yab chos bde kyai gnyis dang gur lcam dral zhal bzhi nor skyong zung dkar bdud phur srung bcas la gtor 'bul shin tu bsdus pa'i lag len 'di ltar te/ gur zhal sogs kyi rten yod na de nyid kyi drung dang / gzhan ji ltar rigs par stegs steng ras dkar sogs kyis bkab la 'bru snas brgyan pa'i dbus su yi dam gnyis la thun mong du zlum gtor gcig g.yas su gur nas phur srung yan la thun mong du zlum gtor gcig g.yon du mkha' 'gro spyi dang gzhi bdag thun mong du zlum gtor gcig rnams bshams pa'i mdun du chu gnyis/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas rnams bshams/ spro na rang gi mdun du stegs steng rdor dril nang mchod ḍā ma ru 'thor nas rnams bshams pa'am/ ma byung kyang chad pa'i skyon med/ dngos gzhi la rdor dril bshams tshe/ thog mar mchod pa la rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod 'thor tshul dang / gzhan yid kyis dmigs la/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las bandha 'bar ba'i snod du hūm̐ las mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ nyer spyod rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med par gyur/ ḍā dril yod tshe dkrol la/ oṃ badzra a ha ra li hūm̐ phaṭa/ puṣpe/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke gandhe/ nai wi dye/ shapta/ u da pha la ya bi pu ra ye hūm̐ phaṭaḥ zhes pas byin gyis brlabs la ḍā dril bzhag skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ni/ nam mkhar rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum dmigs pa'i sku dge 'dun/ gsung dam chos/ thugs bla ma sangs rgyas kyi rang bzhin can la rang gzhan thams cad skyabs su 'gro bar mos te/

ngag tu/ bla ma sangs rgyas chos tshogs la/ /byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ /'gro ba'i don du yi dam lha/ /yongs su bsgom par sems bskyed do/ /lan gsum/ stong pa'i ngang las rang rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams nas spros pa'i khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ rang nyid gang du gnas pa'i zhing 'di rdo rje'i gur khang du gyur pa'i dbus su chos 'byung gru gsum mthing nag mu khyud rdo rjes spras pa'i lte bar nyi zla drag po pho mo'i steng du rang hūm̐ las rdo rje gzhon nu sku mdog mthing nag sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas gnyis na rdo rje rtse dgu rtse lnga/ g.yon gnyis na me dpung kha ṭwāṃ ga mtha' ma gnyis kyi phur bu bsgril bas yum la 'khyud pa/ de'i pang na 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma sngon mo g.yas 'khor lo g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang dur khrod kyi chas dang / dpal gyi chas brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ rol pa'i stabs kyis me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i skur gyur/ de'i thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ sngon gyi mthar sngags 'phreng gis bskor ba las 'od 'phros/ don gnyis byas tshur 'dus rang la thim/ oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya sarba bighnan bandha hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ces dbang dus kyi dam bca' bzhin bzla/ bzlas tshar ba dang phreng ba la has btab spyi bor reg la/ bdag rgyud byin gyis brlabs tu gsol zhes brjod/ snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pa srung 'khor dang chos 'byung rang la thim/ mdun gyi gtor ma la dmigs te/ gong bzhin/ a mṛ ta dang swa bhā bas bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung dang raṃ las me'i steng du a las thod pa'i lte bar go ku da ha na las ba glang khyi rta glang chen mi'i sha bi mu shu ma ra las dri chen dri chu/ byang sems klad pa rakta/ bhrūṃ aṃ dzrīṃ khaṃ hūm̐ las/ me long mnyam nyid sor rtog bya grub ye shes/

de'i steng nyi ma la gnas pa'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ rlung g.yos/ me sbar/ rdzas zhu ba'i rlangs pa phog pas rkyen byas rdo rje'i hūm̐ las bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'dzag yang 'od 'phros/ phyogs bcu nas gnyis med kyi ye shes bdud rtsi'i rnam par spyan drangs/ rdo rje hūm̐ nyi ma dang bcas pa gtor rdzas kyi bdud rtsi la thim pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur/ oṃ ā hūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ gtor ma'i steng gi nam mkhar 'dab brgyad lte bar nyi ma la gnas pa'i bdud bzhi'i gdan la hūm̐ las kyai rdo rje sku mdog sngon po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa zhabs bzhi pa/ de'i am̐ las rdo rje bdag med ma sngon mo gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ 'dab ma brgyad la zla ba'i steng du gaṃ tsaṃ baṃ ghaṃ paṃ shaṃ laṃ ḍaṃ las lha mo brgyad du gyur te gtso 'khor thams cad kyang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyai rdor lha dgu'i rnam par badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dbang gi lha tshogs badzra sa mā dzaḥ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ badzri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ so so'i rigs bdag gis dbu brgyan/ badzra nī ri ni wi ti sarba saṃ shwa dha ni arghaṃ pra tītstsha swāhā/ bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka he badzra sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma ṇaṃ a dya nutpanna twata oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ puṣpe/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke gandhe/ nai wi dye/ shapta āḥhūm̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lha mo brgyad kyis legs mchod pa'i/ /kyai yi rdo rje'i tshogs la 'dud/ /gtor ma dam pa 'di bzhes la/ /dngos grub rnam gnyis stsal du gsol/ ༈ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥsogs dang / mdun gyi nam mkhar 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhugs pa la/ snying ga'i 'od dur khrod brgyad la phog pas cha brgyad du gyur/

ye shes pa 'khor bcas phaiṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ badzra a ha ra li hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ḍā ki ni sa ma ya satwaṃ dri shya hoḥ oṃ a kā ro sogs gong bzhin/ arghaṃ dang / oṃ āḥhūm̐ gong bzhin/ brtan g.yo'i bdag po he ru ka /'khor dang bcas la dang bas bstod/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bsnams la/ /dngos grub rnam gnyis stsal du gsol/ /nam mkhar dur khrod kyi dbus su pad nyi ro gdan la hūm̐ las nag po chen po gri thod gaṇḍi 'dzin pa dur khrod rgyan can pho nya lnga dang bcas pa'i g.yon du pad zla la e ka dza ṭi sngon mo g.yu bum 'dzin zhing dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa'i lte bar bhyoḥlas 'dod khams ma bong bu la zhon pa sngo nag phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis na gri thod/ g.yon gnyis na mdung rtse gsum dur khrod kyi chas kyi brgyan zhing ba glang gi ko ba dang re lde'i sham thabs can lcags sgrog gis brgyan zhing / bzhon pa la nad rkyal cho lo khram shing bkal ba/ mgon po'i g.yas su pad nyi ro gnad la hūm̐ las tsa turmu kha sngo dkar dmar ba dud kha'i zhal can g.yas g.yon gyi dang po gnyis gri thod/ 'og ma gnyis gri mdung / rus phreng mi rkang gling bu bum pa rnams 'dzin zhing dur khrod kyi chas dang tshangs skud can/ g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa'i g.yas g.yon mdun rgyab tu g.yung mo/ gtum mo/ srin mo/ siṅga lī rnams sngo ljang dmar ser gri thod 'dzin pas bskor ba/ de'i g.yas su pad zla la hūm̐ aṃ las nor skyong yab yum keng rus dbyug thod 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan can/ lcam dral gnyis kyi mdun du dam nyams kyi ro gdan lnga la/ yaṃ maṃ tri tri bhyoḥlas nag po gnod sbyin gri gug nyi ma/ nag mo gnod sbyin spu gri zla ba/ pu tra gri thod/ bha tra sher shing snying / sring mo spu gri rgyu ma 'dzin pa rnams sku mdog mthing nag dur khrod kyi chas kyis brgyan pa/

lcam dral gyi g.yon du pad zla la bhyoḥlas dkar mo nyi zla ri rab gling bzhi 'dzin cing dar gos gsol ba/ g.yon du hūm̐ las bdud rgyal rta nag chibs shing lcags mdung thod phreng 'dzin pa dur khrod kyi rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i mtha' bskor du dam can bcu gnyis ru 'dren sde bzhi la sogs pa pho nya bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba/ thams cad kyang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i sku gsung thugs la oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros pas gtor mgron 'khor bcas badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ padma ka ma lā ya satwaṃ/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya ma hā kā li de wī tsa turmu kha shma sha na pa ti badzra kā la yakṣa kā li yakṣi ni yakṣa pu tra ru tra bha tra ru lu rakṣa si badzra shantiṃ padma kriṣṇa ka pā la badzra kī la ya dha ti ma ma sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba ling kha kha khā hi khā hi/ gsum gyis phul/ arghaṃ dang / oṃ āḥhūm̐ gong bzhin brjod/ bstan pa rin chen skyong mdzad pa'i/ /dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs la 'dud/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bsnams la/ /bar chad zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod/ /oṃ āḥsogs gong bzhin/ phaiṃ/ badzra a ra li hoḥtshar gcig a kā ro mu khaṃ sogs tshar gsum/ phyi nang gi mchod la/ gnas gsum rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /bar chad thams can zhi ba dang / /dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol/ /byin rlabs gong bzhin/ bhu mi pa ti a karṣa ya dzaḥ oṃ āḥkā ro sogs gong bzhin/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gnas bdag gzhi bdag 'khor bcas rnams/ mchod sbyin gtor ma sogs spyi gtor bzhin/ yi ge brgya pa'i mthar/ nyes byas gang yin bzod par gsol/ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swāhā/ badzra muḥ ye shes pa gshegs dam tshig pa rang la thim/ rang gi gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dge 'dis sems can ma lus pa/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa thob gyur cig /mchog gsum srung ma'i mthu stobs kyis/

/nyin mtshan kun tu bde legs shog /'di lta bu'i gtor chog nyung ngu 'di yang sde dge'i gnyer chen bu sgo'i zhal 'don du kun blos sbyar ba dge legs 'phel// //maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 4 kun dga' blo gros/ gtor chog nyung 'dus/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
